verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs say templates are pre-configured Docker image setups. They state that instead of installing PyTorch, configuring JupyterLab and setting up dependencies yourself, you can select an official Runpod PyTorch template and have everything ready instantly. vLLM workers are also documented, and a community user confirms launching third-party templates in a few clicks. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of ComfyUI and CUDA-specific templates, and a listing of the template catalog showing a vLLM Pod template specifically.
